name: Off-Hand Post Jump Hook to the Baseline
setup: Back to the basket on the block, a cone behind you as the defender, ball in both hands.
cues: Same drill with the ball in your less-used hand: slow and clean beats fast and messy.
Step across, ball high, and lift a soft one-hand hook over the reach.
Glue the pivot foot to the floor and turn on the ball of it.

faults.fault: Travelling: the pivot foot slides
faults.fix: Glue the pivot foot to the floor and turn on the ball of it.

faults.fault: Ball held low in the traffic
faults.fix: Keep the ball high and tight at the chin, away from the reach.

name: Jab and Shoot at Game Speed
setup: Catch on the wing in triple threat, a cone in front as the defender.
cues: Full game speed now: if your form slips, drop back to the slower version.
Jab at the cone; if it does not move back, rise and shoot.
Keep the ball tight to the hip, away from the cone.

faults.fault: Standing tall out of triple threat
faults.fix: Stay low and level, like under a low ceiling.

faults.fault: Ball swinging loose
faults.fix: Rip the ball from hip to hip, tight and fast.
